messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Autopager triggered for inference-gateway (us-west1) — symptom=5xx_rate spike (>20% in 1m). PD: PD12345. Auto-escalation: oncall

pagerduty: PagerDuty incident PD12345 created · urgency=high · routed to oncall rotation (Alice M.)

Alice M.: acked PD12345 — I'm on it, grabbing logs and looking at routing.

Ben T.: I can join — checking gateway metrics and kv-cache stats. seeing a big spike in upstream 502/504s from inference-runtime nodes.

Carol N.: grabbing traces now. early look: sudden increase in backend timeouts at ~12:34:10 UTC, many peers returning 502 due to upstream connection reset. stack: gateway -> runtime-proxy -> kv-cache.

Ben T.: quick check, curl to runtime health endpoint shows 502s:```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://runtime-usw1.internal/health
# output sampled:
502 0.102
502 0.098
200 0.012
502 0.110
```

Alice M.: thanks. rolling hypothesis: kv-cache fanout is getting overloaded causing connection resets -> runtime returning 502 -> gateway bubbling as 5xx. Might be an autoscale lag or network flapping.

David (SRE): I see a matching spike in cluster node network retransmits starting 12:33:50. Could be a noisy node triggering connection queues.

Ben T.: mitigation plan: 1) divert 20% traffic to fallback model pool (lower throughput but stable) 2) bump LB idle timeout from 30s -> 60s for gateway to reduce premature resets 3) scale kv-cache pool +1 replica. Doing in that order.

Alice M.: executing 1) feature-flag split via rollout service: `rollout set traffic inference-gateway --split fallback=20%` — applying now.

support-bot: statuspage draft ready: "Investigating increased 5xx errors in US-West for inference API. Working on mitigation. Customers may see failed requests or higher latency." — want to publish?

Alice M.: publish the draft, mention ETA 15m for mitigation window.

Ben T.: scaling kv-cache: `kubectl scale deployment kv-cache --replicas=5 -n prod-usw1` — scaled. watching replication.

Carol N.: after routing split, 5xx rate dropped from 22% -> 7% in the last 30s. traces show fewer connection resets to runtime. Looks like routing helped.

David (SRE): LB timeout bumped, just patched config on loadbalancer pool. no more premature connection closures observed.

Alice M.: good. keeping oncall until stable. I'll keep PD open for 30m and then hand off if stable. Posting update to PD and statuspage: mitigation applied, reduced error rate, continuing monitoring.

Ben T.: agree — will monitor for 15 more mins. followups: create runbook item for kv-cache autoscale thresholds and add circuit breaker metric in gateway to detect this earlier.

support-bot: statuspage published: "Mitigation deployed — traffic partly routed to fallback pool. Error rate reduced. Monitoring."

Alice M.: PD note: acknowledge -> mitigation applied -> keeping incident open for monitoring. Handoff planned if stable at 13:05 UTC.

incident-bot: PD12345 status updated: acknowledged by Alice M.; assigned to Ben T. for monitoring; auto-reminder in 15m.

Alice M.: final check: 5xx rate steady at ~3-4% over 5m window, p99 latency nominal. I'm going to handoff to Ben in 15 for watch — Ben, please escalate if anything regresses.

Ben T.: will do. logging follow-up ticket INF-1876 for runbook + autoscale adjustments.

Alice M.: thanks all — updating postmortem template and will link INF-1876. closing slack thread here, will post final summary to #postmortems once the blameless postmortem is drafted. :white_check_mark:
